technique_name: Describe how the given engineering concept works.
description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is a branch of computer science that uses sophisticated algorithms to enable computers to think like humans and solve complex problems. AI works by taking a problem and breaking it down into pieces that the computer can understand. The machine then looks for patterns in data and creates models or a “decision tree” to make informed decisions.
